series.name: All Enviro AC lines — Titan / Iceberg / Classic / Alpha / Eco / Marvel / Thunder-TQ / Glacier / ACE / A-Cool / H-Cool / Ultimate+ floor-standing (shared platform)
series.notes: Enviro Appliances (JW Corp, est. 2015, Lahore) — PK brand. Verified lines on enviro.com.pk: wall splits Titan (EAC-12/18Titan), Iceberg (EAC-12/18/24IB), Classic (EAC-12/24CL), Alpha (EINV-12/18AS), Eco (EAINV-12/18/24E, EAC-12E), Marvel (EAC-18MS), Big Show (EAC-19TBS), A-Cool (EAC-12A Cool), H-Cool (EAC-18H Cool), Thunder/TQ MAX (EAC-12/18/24TQ), Glacier (EAC-12/18HU), ACE (EAC-12/18/24QY), TQ Grande (EAC-18TQ); floor standing Ultimate+ (EAC-48 Ultimate+ H&C 4-ton) plus warranty-listed TG GRANDE / TG GRANDE PLUS / DX GALAXY / DX GALAXY PLUS. No cassette/duct line confirmed. DOCUMENTED GAP: no official Enviro fault-code table; user-manuals page renders no PDF. Only one verified code: E9 refrigerant leak (official product pages + 8+ retailers, high). Enviro appears to rebrand an OEM platform (import hints: Zhongshan Changhong) — generic E/F/P tables may apply but are NOT imported (unverified). Support: after-sales (042) 111-88-44-22 / +92 320 0845120 / info@enviro.com.pk.

source.title: Enviro Appliances official — product pages (Titan / Classic / A-Cool) with E9 leak-detection note

notes.en: Official Enviro product pages + 8+ PK retailers agree E9 = refrigerant leak detection (high). Exact display channel (indoor panel vs remote vs LED) not stated in sources. Do NOT import other brands' E9 meanings (Haier/Gree/TCL/Dawlance map E9 to fan/sensor/indoor faults). If an Enviro unit shows EC/EL 0C instead, treat as unverified for Enviro — not automatically equal to E9.
notes.ur: Official Enviro pages + 8+ PK retailers agree ke E9 = refrigerant leak detection (high). Exact display channel (indoor panel vs remote vs LED) sources mein nahi. Doosron brands ki E9 meaning na lagayein (Haier/Gree/TCL/Dawlance E9 ko fan/sensor/indoor fault batate hain). Agar Enviro unit EC/EL 0C dikhaye to unverified maaniyein - E9 ke barabar na maanein.
